products.short: A light, watery toner that gently sweeps away dead skin cells and leaves skin hydrated and refreshed. Mineral-rich deep sea water from Ulleungdo and Dokdo, with hyaluronic acid, panthenol, allantoin and betaine, calms tired skin and absorbs quickly without a sticky finish.

products.name: ROUND LAB - 1025 Dokdo Toner
products.current_short: Amp up your cleansing routine with this gentle yet powerful cleansing foam that thoroughly removes makeup residue and impurities. The formula is chock-full of deep sea water and three types of hyaluronic acid to keep skin hydrated post-wash. Panthenol, allantoin and ceramide NP form a protective barrier over skin to seal in moisture.
products.current_desc:
Benefits:
SIMPLE YET EXCEPTIONAL : This outstanding toner exfoliates dead skin cells and replenishes skin with long-lasting moisture.
WATER-LIKE TEXTURE : It absorbs instantly into the skin with no sticky finish.
KEEP YOUR SKIN HYDRATED : Panthenol, Allantoin, and Betaine provide soothing care for tired and irritated skin.
Made in Korea
How to use:
After cleansing, soak cotton pad with toner and gently swipe all over your face.
If using the leave-on method, soak cotton pads with toner and leave on face for 5 to 10 minutes.
About brand: ROUND LAB
Inspired by the Korean Peninsula’s abundance of natural resources, ROUND LAB uses natural ingredients in skin care products that purify and revitalize skin. The Korean brand constantly searches for top-notch ingredients across Korea to use in its products. The brand’s bestselling 1025 Dokdo line, for instance, is formulated with mineral-rich sea water sourced from the Ulleungdo and Dokdo islands. There’s also the moisturizing Birch Juice line enriched with silver birch sap from Inje county. ROUND LAB also offers skin-soothing products made with mugwort from Geomundo, like the Mugwort Calming Cleanser and Toner and Mugwort Calming Mask. All products are 100% made in Korea.

About brand: Purito SEOUL

Korean skin care brand Purito SEOUL draws inspiration from Korean ingredients and culture to create effective skin care solutions for all, including those with sensitive skin. Its products seamlessly blend natural ingredients with clinically proven actives to treat various skin concerns. Purito SEOUL's Wonder Releaf Centella Line features centella asiatica from Korea as the key ingredient for quick relief of skin redness and irritation. A popular holy grail product from the collection is the Wonder Releaf Centella Serum Unscented, a water-gel serum infused with cica extract and peptides for skin-revitalizing and soothing benefits. All Purito SEOUL products are vegan and cruelty-free. All products are 100% made in Korea.

products.current_desc:
Benefits:
This device is designed for various skin needs, delivering efficient and elevated care in a single use.
With 6 modes and LED indication, you can create your own routine for a more complete care experience.
Maximized absorption up to 1,332% for a plump, radiant glow skin.
Comprehensive volume and line improvement for the forehead, frown lines, neck, eye areas, and smile lines.

This
AGE-R Booster Pro X2 Pink
comes with:
AGE-R Booster Pro X2 Pink 1 pc
English User Manual 1 pc
USB Charging Cable 1 pc
Modes Available:
Red LED: Glow boosting Booster X2 Mode
Green LED: MC X2 Mode for plump-looking skin
Orange LED: Derma Shot X2 Mode for skin definition care
Yellow LED: Dual Mode that uses two modes simultaneously
Purple LED: A mode designed to be used with a sheet mask to promote absorption
Blue LED: Pore and exfoliation care Air Shot X2 Mode
How to use:
Before first-time use, fully charge the device.
Apply a sufficient amount of skincare product to the treatment area.
Press and hold the power button for 2-3 seconds to turn on the device.
Press the Mode Button once to select the desired mode. Each press changes the mode, which is shown on the LCD Screen along with a voice guide and the mode-specific LED color on the Central LED Indicator. *Modes change in the following order: Booster X2 Mode - MC X2 Mode - Derma Shot X2 Mode - Dual Mode - Mask Mode - Air Shot X2 Mode.
After selecting the mode, briefly press the Level Button once to adjust the level. Each press increases the level by one, and the changed level is displayed on the LCD Screen each time the level increases.
For the first time use, start at level 1 intensity and gradually increase the level after an adjustment period.
Press and hold the Power Button and the Mode Button together for more than 3 seconds to change the voice guide language. English, Korean, Japanese, and Chinese are available.
After the care, pat the remaining skincare product into the skin for better absorption.
Remove any residue of skincare products with a clean cloth and store it in a well-ventilated and cool place.*Avoid using the device around the eyes and the Adam’s apple area. *Keep the device away from any magnetic object such as a credit card, TV, or monitor.
*Do not use if you are a patient with wearable electronic devices, electrical life-support equipment, or mounted electrical medical equipment.

Kojic acid, turmeric and niacinamide target dullness and uneven-looking tone, while the device helps your serum absorb for a brighter, more even complexion.

products.name: Medicube - Kojic Acid Turmeric Booster Pro Set
products.current_desc:
Elevate your skincare ritual with this powerhouse collection designed to target stubborn hyperpigmentation, uneven skin tone, and dullness. By combining Medicube’s cutting-edge device technology with the brightening synergy of Kojic Acid, Turmeric, and Niacinamide, this set offers a professional-grade facial experience from the comfort of home.
Made in Korea
What’s included in the Set?
Medicube – AGE-R Booster Pro (Yellow Edition)
Experience spa-like beauty treatments at home with medicube’s AGE-R Booster Pro. It features four easy-to-use modes: Booster mode for delivering skin care deep into skin, MC mode for face-lifting using microcurrents, Derma Shot mode for muscle-relaxing using electromagnetic stimulation (EMS), and Air Shot mode for pore care effects. Each mode is supplemented by customizable sonic vibrations, and different colored LED indicator lights for easy switching between functions. The device can also be connected via Bluetooth to the AGE-R Booster Pro mobile app for remote control and other functions.
medicube – Kojic Acid Turmeric Pad
One swipe express to glass-skin? Yes please! With kojic acid and turmeric root extract as star ingredients, medicube’s Kojic Acid Turmeric Pad is a whiz at fading dark spots, brightening the complexion and protecting skin from external aggressors. Infused with chemical exfoliants like AHA (glycolic acid) and BHA (salicylic acid), the toner pads make rough skin feel baby-smooth again!
medicube – Kojic Acid Turmeric Niacinamide Serum
Your dark spots don’t stand a chance against medicube’s triple-threat serum that combines kojic acid, turmeric and niacinamide. This do-it-all brightening serum evens skin tone, soothes irritation and refines skin texture for a more radiant complexion. It’s also infused with snowflake-like capsules containing squalane and thioctic acid, boosting absorption and hydrating skin.
medicube – Kojic Acid Turmeric Night Wrapping Mask
Restore skin’s youthful glow overnight with this sleeping mask. It’s packed with kojic acid, turmeric root extract and collagen for brightening and anti-aging benefits. The clinically tested formula is suitable for sensitive skin. Apply a moderate amount on the entire face and allow it to dry completely before going to bed. In the morning, gently peel it off and then rinse off with lukewarm water.
How to Use the Set
Prep: Swipe a Kojic Acid Pad over a clean, dry face to exfoliate and prep the skin.
Treat: Apply a generous amount of the Kojic Acid Turmeric Niacinamide Serum.

This 2-step mask with Hydrop Reedle Shot formula fills the skin with moisture from the inside.
